name: c-di-GMP type II riboswitch bound to cyclic-di-GMP
preparationNotes: Chain R used (1984 ATOM records). Chain P (712 atoms) excluded. 4 Mg2+ ions in chain R removed per Mg anomaly policy. GTP R:8 (5' terminal nucleotide, listed as HETATM) included in receptor as ATOM. C2E (c-di-GMP) at R:1 is the ligand. Box 28x28x28 A (c-di-GMP is large, MW=690). Actives/decoys reused from 3IRW GEMM-I for direct fold comparison.
source: RCSB PDB 3MXH; Kulshina N et al. Nat Struct Mol Biol 2009 doi:10.1038/nsmb.1561
affinitySource: Kulshina et al. 2009; Kd ~1 nM for c-di-GMP
affinityNotes: GEMM-II c-di-GMP riboswitch from V. cholerae. Sub-nanomolar affinity. Different fold from GEMM-I (3IRW) — enables paired fold-dependent scoring analysis for cyclic dinucleotide ligands.
notes: GEMM-II c-di-GMP riboswitch, 2.30 A X-ray. Both guanine bases stack on receptor; phosphodiester backbone makes key contacts. Companion to 3IRW.
